blake3
------

[![GoDoc](https://godoc.org/lukechampine.com/blake3?status.svg)](https://godoc.org/lukechampine.com/blake3)
[![Go Report Card](http://goreportcard.com/badge/lukechampine.com/blake3)](https://goreportcard.com/report/lukechampine.com/blake3)

```
go get lukechampine.com/blake3
```

`blake3` implements the [BLAKE3 cryptographic hash function](https://github.com/BLAKE3-team/BLAKE3).
This implementation aims to be performant without sacrificing (too much)
readability, in the hopes of eventually landing in `x/crypto`.

In addition to the pure-Go implementation, this package also contains AVX-512,
AVX2, and NEON routines (generated by [`avo`](https://github.com/mmcloughlin/avo))
that greatly increase performance for large inputs and outputs.

## Benchmarks

Tested on an Apple M5 (10 cores) and on a VM with 4 cores of an Intel Haswell
CPU. Inputs and outputs of more than a few dozen kilobytes are processed with
multiple goroutines. (I do not currently have access to an AVX-512 machine.)

### NEON (Apple M5)

```
BenchmarkSum256/64            55.9 ns/op     1145.87 MB/s
BenchmarkSum256/1024           756 ns/op     1355.42 MB/s
BenchmarkSum256/65536        27168 ns/op     2412.52 MB/s
BenchmarkSum256/1048576     143802 ns/op     7291.81 MB/s
BenchmarkWrite                 414 ns/op     2474.31 MB/s
BenchmarkXOF/64                374 ns/op      170.91 MB/s
BenchmarkXOF/1024              375 ns/op     2733.73 MB/s
BenchmarkXOF/65536           17070 ns/op     3839.44 MB/s
BenchmarkXOF/1048576        129776 ns/op     8079.92 MB/s
```
